title: MODE 1: COMP (General Computation)
summary: Default environment for arithmetic, trigonometry, logarithms, exponentials, fractions, and coordinate transformations.

body.text: COMP is the everyday mode. It supports continuous calculations, variable store/recall, CONST, FMLA, and multi-statement work with Ans chaining. Angle results follow the current Deg/Rad/Gra SET UP.

body.label: When to leave COMP
body.text: Switch to CMPLX for i, BASE for hex/bin logic, SD/REG for statistics buffers, or PRGM to edit code. Mixing statistic DT entry in COMP will not fill the SD/REG buffers.
